profile.headline: Software Developer & Integrator  at USAA
profile.summary: I'm currently a CIS major at Texas State University, proficient in Visual Studio, Swift 4, Microsoft SQL Server, Xcode, Android Studio, and several Microsoft Applications including Word, Excel, Powerpoint, and Access. I aspire to work in the cyber security industry, and am a life-long learner.  I have management experience but more importantly have many management skills and a strong passion to succeed in my career. I am a responsible, dependable, and creative person with analytical skills that looks forward to the challenges and possibilities that each new day brings. My background as a musician and audio engineer has fortified my creativity; this translates to the business world in an ability to approach obstacles with an outside perspective and objectivity that produces new solutions. I love learning new skills, refining my abilities, and envision being a valued resource to a firm; someone who can lead, mentor, train, and deliver on any task asked of me.

positions.title: Warehouse Associate
positions.description: I ensure that freight is processed efficiently and accurately, and assist management with training and coaching of new associates. I coordinate back-room activities to increase productivity in receiving, and provide world class customer service.

positions.title: Collection Specialist
positions.description: Collecting outstanding municipal court fees and fines. I was consistently a leader in revenue collected and efficiency analytics for the San Antonio Fees & Fines Call Center.

positions.title: Merchanding Manager
positions.description: While developing and maintaining a strong  customer focus I managed the home department including leased business division of shoes. Followed merchandising guidelines and utilized sales reports to improve sales performance within the department. Communicated merchandise needs or issues to senior management and corporate buyers. Set ads, completed markdowns and created visual displays. Managed workflow within the dept., made associated schedules and assisted with selecting, supervising, and developing staff. Served as manager on duty, which included store opening, closing, and performing cash audits. Selected for the "A" Team in opening store #255 in McAllen, TX - Sept 2012

positions.title: Department Lead
positions.description: Receive and merchandise new product weekly while maintaining high standards in appearance and implementing all directives from corporate. Ensure all leased business division manifests are current and accurate. Merchandising and creating visual displays for home dept., while providing customer service and register duties when needed. Setting sales floor according to corporate directives with proper price signage.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: Relationship selling of products, services, and solutions for customers' unique individual needs. Utilizing all relevant sales tools to drive profitable growth. Operating cash register for sales and returns.
